documents.docs/backup.md:
# Backup recovery
restore_snapshot recovers database records from a verified nightly backup.
It does not roll back the application image or change deployment traffic.
documents.docs/cache-ttl.md:
# Cache expiry
cache_ttl_seconds sets the lifetime of a cached response.
Expiry removes stale values automatically; explicit invalidation removes them immediately.
documents.docs/canary.md:
# Canary deployment
canary_percentage limits traffic to the new release during a gradual rollout.
This strategy differs from switching all traffic between blue and green environments.
documents.docs/database-timeout.md:
# SQL 超时
statement_timeout 限制单条 SQL 语句的执行时间，不控制数据库连接池大小。
超时后回滚当前事务，并保留错误日志用于诊断。
documents.docs/database.md:
# 数据库

数据库连接池配置位于服务启动参数中，默认保留十个连接。
documents.docs/deployment.md:
# Deployment

Production releases use a blue-green rollout so traffic can switch safely.
documents.docs/errors.md:
# Errors

E_AUTH_401 means that authentication credentials were rejected.
documents.docs/health.md:
# Service readiness
readiness_probe checks whether a service can accept requests before routing traffic.
liveness_probe restarts an unresponsive process and is not a deployment strategy.
documents.docs/password-reset.md:
# Password recovery
reset_password sends a one-time recovery link to the registered email address.
The recovery credential is not an access bearer token or a refresh token.
documents.docs/permission-error.md:
# Authorization failures
E_AUTH_403 means the user is authenticated but lacks permission to access the resource.
Do not refresh the bearer token to fix a missing role assignment.
documents.docs/rate-limit.md:
# Rate limiting
E_RATE_429 indicates too many requests. retry_after_seconds controls client backoff.
Authentication may have succeeded; this error is not a token verification failure.
documents.docs/redis-pool.md:
# Redis 连接池
缓存连接池通过 redis_pool_size 配置，限制 Redis 客户端的并发连接。
它和 SQL 数据库连接池分别管理，不能共用连接。
documents.docs/rollback.md:
# Rollback procedure
rollback_release restores the previous stable image after deployment health checks fail.
Keep the earlier image until the rollout has passed the observation window.
documents.docs/token-refresh.md:
# Token refresh
refresh_token rotates an expired access token using a refresh credential.
It does not verify the bearer signature; verify_token handles that separately.
